description: Repeats an element for each item of an array, object, number range or iterable: `v-for="(item, index) in items"`.
A unique, stable primitive that tells Vue which DOM node belongs to which item, so it can move nodes instead of patching them in place.
Default strategy without keys: reuse nodes by position and update their content. Breaks stateful elements when items move.
`push`, `pop`, `shift`, `unshift`, `splice`, `sort` and `reverse` on reactive arrays trigger updates. `filter`/`map` return new arrays that must be assigned.
